raw: The X-translation improved the error (284 mm → 334 mm), but it’s still far from the tolerance. The door is still not closing properly, suggesting the hinge alignment or swing plane is misconfigured. Since the door must swing 90 degrees without collision, I will now attempt a small negative Y-rotation on P1 to adjust its swing orientation and reduce interpenetration during closure. This may help the door align properly without jamming. I will use a small rotation of -3 degrees to test its effect.
